---
name: pm-status
description: Show your saved PM requests and what needs your attention.
---

Run helper list and status for selected requests. Show title,
request key, status, stage, gate, revision and critic rounds. Report visible errors
without copying full sources into a status summary. Do not run models, retry,
approve, export or collect sources.
Do not invent command results or treat descriptive counts as quality measurements.
For "Show my PM requests", present a short list of titles and the next required
action, not raw JSON. Keep run IDs/revisions available internally. Use
`docs/copilot-reference.md` for commands. Do not require the user to run them.
